semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in high-purity specialty gases and electronic chemicals critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: APK (Shanghai) Gas Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise focused on the research, development, production, and sales of ultra-high purity specialty gases and electronic chemicals for the semiconductor industry. With production bases and R&D centers in Jiangsu and Hebei, the company provides essential materials for advanced semiconductor manufacturing, including applications in chip manufacturing and advanced packaging.
capabilities: Ultra-high purity electronic specialty gases for dry etching and doping
N-type and P-type doping sources for micro-nano fabrication
Specialty gases for thin film deposition in advanced logic and memory chips
High-performance precursor materials for compound semiconductors

regional_presence.China: The company has established production bases and R&D centers in Jiangsu and Hebei provinces.
